dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #Let the wind lead, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It is very comfortable here.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The air is fresh and the environment is restful.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It is also very quiet. I think I will be able to concentrate and get a lot of work done here.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Hmm? Is that not alright?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You should try to enjoy yourself here.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Thank you...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I'll be sure to keep your suggestion firmly in mind.

choices.text: You should try to enjoy this place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Of course, it's always a pleasure to be in your company.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Is there a particular topic that you wish to discuss?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I apologize... Evidently, I talk about work so much that it gets quite exasperating for the people around me.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I will think on this.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Jean, no need to take it so seriously...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I—I am sorry...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I understand. You mean to say that we should be more informal in the way we interact with each other.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: O—Okay, I...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I will do my best...

choices.text: I've heard that you sing quite well?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: ...Only a few simple songs.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: It's really nothing to brag about.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I want to hear you sing.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Ah, um... But I'm completely unprepared...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: At the very least, let me practice first.

choices.text: If that works for you, it works for me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Perhaps you could join me for a walk?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I have taken what you said recently to heart and tried to make a few adjustments in my life.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Of course, I still push myself to complete my work when performing my official duties.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: But when I'm with you, I'm now able to unwind.

choices.text: Sounds like you're making great progress.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: This is all thanks to you...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: This whole time, you have been a great companion to me. You are always so considerate of my circumstances.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: It would be shameful if I didn't at least recognize this much.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: So, thank you. Truly.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You look beautiful when you smile.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I should thank you, too.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: We... should walk while we talk.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I still have so much I want to say to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Jean.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I wish you a successful journey.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: If there is anything I can assist with, please do not hesitate to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Jean.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Good night. Try not to stay up too late...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...as you often remind me yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I never thought that such a perfect study could exist outside the Knights of Favonius headquarters.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I would certainly feel at ease here, whether it be while reading or working.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Thank you, Honorary Knight. I am very satisfied.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Whenever I go for a stroll around Mondstadt and see the citizens happy and free, I feel deeply inspired.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The Knights perform our duty precisely so that the city's residents may live in peace.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The atmosphere in this park is excellent. Thank you...
